name: Streaky Bay Great White Shark Replica
reason: Quirky roadside icon: 5 m fibreglass great white replica the tourism board lists among the town's most photographed attractions; a guide-named big thing.

name: Streaky Bay Back Beach
reason: Tourism board names the surf beach 8 km from town; second-tier beach stop a guide names. Distinct from the Granites and Smooth Pool.

name: Hally's Beach
reason: Duplicate: a stop on the Cape Bauer loop (judged as Cape Bauer); short pull-out, one source.

name: Surfers Beach Streaky Bay
reason: Gentle local beach, single tourism-board listing with no distinct draw beyond ordinary beach time; searched tourism board and Wikivoyage only.

name: Smooth Pool
reason: Tourism board lists the granite-shelf rock pool for swimming and snorkelling on Westall Way: a named natural swim stop.

name: High Cliff
reason: Tourism board lists the clifftop lookout over the Southern Ocean on Westall Way: a named headland/lookout stop (second tier).

name: Streaky Bay Pioneers Park
reason: Ordinary town park, no named visitor draw; one source.

name: Smoky Bay Jetty
reason: Small-town jetty, no named things to see or do; one source.

name: Nuyts Archipelago Conservation Park
reason: For: islands and sea lion/bird tours are a real draw named by the tourism board and Wikipedia confirms the park. Against: boat-only, reached via operators, Franklin Islands prohibited, one counted source.

name: Acraman Creek Conservation Park
reason: Two counted sources (parks.sa.gov.au, tourism board) name mangroves, canoeing, fishing and shorebirds west of Ceduna; a conservation park with named activities.

name: Ceduna Jetty
reason: Wikivoyage and tourism board both name the long Ceduna jetty with ocean views; a guide-named harbour stop, a half-hour walk.

name: Ceduna Museum
reason: For: two counted sources list the National Trust museum. Against: very limited opening hours (10am to noon), small local museum.

name: Ceduna Aboriginal Arts and Culture Centre
reason: For: Wikivoyage lists Tjutjuna/Arts Ceduna Aboriginal art display. Against: single source, link dead, mostly a gallery shop and listing may be stale.

name: Denial Bay Jetty
reason: Local jetty near Ceduna, one tourism-board source, no named draw.

name: OTC Satellite Earth Station
reason: For: tourism board names the 1969 satellite earth station, a distinctive history stop 34 km from Ceduna. Against: unmanned, perimeter-fence view only, one counted source.

name: Nullarbor Plain
reason: A region crossed by highway, not a single place; real stops (Bunda Cliffs, Head of Bight, roadhouses) are separate spots. Wikivoyage Eyre Peninsula names it only as an area.

name: Nullarbor Links
reason: A 1,365 km route of golf holes across two states, not one place; single source.

name: Googs Track
reason: Parks SA and a tour page name the 4WD desert track through Yumbarra/Yellabinna to Goog's Lake; a real outback drive guides promote (4WD-only noted in bio).

name: Mamungari Conservation Park
reason: Remote desert park on Maralinga Tjarutja country; listings give no walk, lookout or visitor facilities a traveller can do in half an hour, and access is permit/4WD-expedition only.

name: Lake Gilles Conservation Park
reason: Two counted sources (parks.sa.gov.au, tourism board) name the salt lake and walking trails near Kimba; free and open.

name: Lake Newland Conservation Park
reason: Two counted sources (parks.sa.gov.au, tourism board) name the coastal lake and sandhills; a walk and 4WD beach destination.

name: Lake Macdonnell
reason: Tourism board lists the pink salt lake near Penong on Point Sinclair Road; a quirky natural roadside stop a guide names.

name: Sir Joseph Banks Group Conservation Park
reason: Two counted sources (parks.sa.gov.au, tourism board) name the island group with sea lion and bird viewing via boat tours from Tumby Bay/Port Lincoln; the islands are the place, the boat just access.

name: Tumby Bay National Trust Museum
reason: For: Wikivoyage See lists the National Trust museum. Against: small branch museum, one source, unclear hours.

name: Colour Tumby Bay Street Art
reason: Tourism board lists the town's street art trail, free and always open; a walkable half-hour trail.

name: Franklin Harbor Conservation Park
reason: Wikivoyage Cowell See names the mangroves and samphire flats with sea birds, 5 km out of town; a conservation park with wildlife viewing.

name: Cowell Agriculture Museum
reason: For: tourism board lists the agriculture museum. Against: small local museum, single source, no detail on opening.

name: Arno Bay Estuary Boardwalk
reason: Tourism board and Wikivoyage (Tumby Bay Go next) both name the boardwalk through the mangroves to the beach; a half-hour walk.

name: Cleve Hills Scenic Drive and Lookout
reason: Tourism board (agreed by southaustralia.com) names the scenic drive and lookout over the district; second-tier lookout.

name: Darke Peak
reason: Tourism board lists the Darke Peak scenic drive with the hill and Darke monument; a named drive and lookout stop.

name: Yeldulknie Conservation Park
reason: Tourism board lists the conservation park with weir reservoir and hiking trail near Cleve; a named walk.

name: Carappee Hill Conservation Park
reason: Tourism board lists the conservation park hill with a hiking trail; a named walk.
